sections.content: Combine the pretérito perfecto with *alguna* *vez* and *nunca* to ask about and describe experiences. Use familiar verbs and beach or excursion vocabulary.

items.spanish: ¿Has estado alguna vez en un pueblo costero?
items.english: Have you ever been to a coastal village?

items.spanish: Sí, he estado en un pueblo costero.
items.english: Yes, I have been to a coastal village.

items.spanish: No, nunca he probado el marisco.
items.english: No, I have never tried seafood.

sections.content: Think of *alguna* *vez* and *nunca* as opposite ends of the same scale: alguna vez asks whether the door has ever been opened at all, nunca slams it shut for good.
